lines.zh: 我的触腕往后一收，身子就射出去。
lines.en: My arms gather and my body shoots forward.

lines.zh: 深水里我的颜色慢慢变浅。
lines.en: In deep water I fade paler.
I glide along the rock wall.
My eyes are bigger than my head should allow.

lines.zh: 一条触腕在身后拖得很长。
lines.en: One arm trails far behind me.
I thread around a wrecked mast.

lines.zh: 水压在我身上像一床被子。
lines.en: The pressure lies on me like a blanket.

lines.zh: 我从暗处挪到另一处暗处。
lines.en: I move from one dark place to another.

lines.zh: 触腕上的吸盘一张一合。
lines.en: The suckers on my arms open and close.
I beat my fins and rise slowly.
My shadow slides across the seabed.

lines.zh: 水流从我身体两侧分开。
lines.en: The current splits around my body.
I stop and let my body drift.

lines.zh: 一只小鱼躲进了我的腕间。
lines.en: A small fish hides among my arms.
I twist my body, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我把一条触腕探进石缝。
lines.en: I feel a crevice with one arm.

lines.zh: 暗里只有我的眼睛是亮的。
lines.en: In the dark, only my eyes shine.
One arm curls above my head.
I listen to water sounds far off.

lines.zh: 皮肤上的斑点忽明忽暗。
lines.en: The spots on my skin pulse.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块沉木。
lines.en: I stay still, like sunken timber.
Something touched the tip of an arm.
I slowly exchange one breath of water.
In the deep blue there's only me.
I draw my arms in a little.
There's light overhead, very far.
I'm waiting for something to pass.
My beak hides among the arms.
My arms sink an inch into the mud.
I let my arms trail on the bottom.
You've dived deeper than I expected.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛转过来对着你。
lines.en: My eye turns to you.
You carry bubbles.
One of my arms is a block from you.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚蹼拍得太响。
lines.en: Your fins slap too loudly.
This deep water is mine.
I counted your movements.
Your light doesn't reach me.

lines.zh: 我看着你的气泡往上升。
lines.en: Your bubbles are rising.
I spread my arms.
I release a cloud of ink.
My body contracts.
One arm falls loose.
My gills taste blood.
I draw back slowly.
My colour goes white all at once.
The spots on me go dark.
I make one very low sound.
I'm still in the water. Still here.
I pull all my arms in.
Fish smell from above.
Let it sink down to me.
Blood reaches my gills.
One arm has already reached out.
This will make a meal.
I curl around it.
Don't pull; it'll tear.
This is too small.
I draw my arms back slowly.
I taste it.
You bump into one of my arms.
I loosen the arm and slide past.
Your shove scatters my arms.
Between us the water churns.
An arm rests against your back.
I don't hit back.
You're nudged aside a little.

lines.zh: 我的吸盘抓住了你的袖子。
lines.en: A sucker grips your sleeve.
I draw it back slowly.
This space is too narrow.
Another one hangs in the dark.
Our arms entwine.
Her spots are brighter than yours.
We place the eggs in a crevice.
She rises; I follow.
We make no sound.
I see my reflection in her eye.
The current presses us together.
We drift together for a long time.
She loosens her arms; so do I.
I curl an arm around it.
The ink sac sways beneath me.
There's something on this sunken wood.
I bring it to my beak.
It's hard; I can't bite it.
I hide it among my arms.
It shows even in the dark.
It slides off a sucker.
I tuck it among my arms.
It tastes of iron.
My pupil is fixed on it.
The water in the dark is disturbed.
I extend one arm.
It's very close.
The pressure helps me.
I mark it and draw my arms in.
It swims up; perfect.

lines.zh: 我的触腕已经绕过它了。
lines.en: My arm has already gone around it.
I begin to draw in.
This will be quiet.
I follow from below.
I'm inside its shadow.
My arms spread wider.
It hasn't noticed the water.
The gap keeps shrinking.
I pass beneath its shadow.
It's starting to sink.
One more block will do.
An arm has touched it.
It's overhead now.
Several arms close at once.
My beak bites down.
It's dragged into the deep.
Ink spreads in a cloud.
I coil around its leg.
It thrashes hard.
The pressure holds it still.
I loosen, then tighten.
The suckers hold it fast.
I draw it slowly upward.
A patch of black appears in the deep.
I slowly spread my arms.
The pressure suddenly changes.
I rise out of the dark.
In the deep, I unfold one arm.
Down here it's quieter than above.
A small fish darts away.
My fins beat gently.
A little mud lifts off the bottom.
I've found this stone.

lines.zh: 热从上面压下来，我的腕都缩了。
lines.en: Heat presses down; all my arms retract.

lines.zh: 我摔在硬地上，腕全摊开。
lines.en: I hit hard ground, arms splayed.

lines.zh: 我在不该淹的地方被水压住了。
lines.en: I'm crushed by water where I shouldn't be.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的墨全震了出来。
lines.en: The blast forces all my ink out.
A harpoon lodges in one arm.
The water suddenly disobeys me.
So empty I can't lift an arm.
Lightning enters the water; I convulse.
No water, and no dark either.
